source_map_meta.description: World geography generated from the legacy transcription and reconciled, source-backed authoring records.
source_map_meta.schema_notes: Nodes are land/sea tiles. City status (`is_city`) is separate from terrain. Each neighbor entry describes source -> neighbor. `border_terrain` is a string or a list of simultaneous first-round terrains, e.g. ["desert", "mountain"], not inferred from node terrain. `has_river` describes a river route; `river_crossing` is a directional combat crossing. `naval_facilities` and matching `naval_facility_ids` are paired physical instances. Repeated types with distinct IDs are separate facilities; the same ID on two coast edges is one shared facility. Intrinsic facilities use `node_facilities` / `node_facility_ids`. Reviewed direct land narrow crossings have `narrow_crossing`, printed unit capacity in the legacy-named `narrow_crossings`, and `narrow_crossing_sea_zones` for all blocking seas. They are constrained crossings under rule 1.9, not unrestricted land adjacency. `railway_connection` is a reciprocal boolean regardless of the number of drawn tracks; `gauge_change` remains separate. Rule 10.6.2 (p. 67) bombs all railroads on a border together. Damage is mutable game state, not encoded by the static rail presence flag.
warnings: Physical geography is reviewed within recorded field scopes; legacy attributes are not automatically certified.
Uncertain findings and nested fields remain deferred in gw36_manual_map_review.json.
Canada seam rulings and adopted China-theatre directional values remain project decisions; their source status is preserved.
Special routes and geographic rule references do not implement runtime permissions, combat or scenario setup.
source_map_meta.unknown_values: null means not source-reviewed; false means an authored negative or a retained legacy value whose review status is in the sidecar.
source_map_meta.current_owner_semantics: Legacy setup hint only; original_owner is static identity. Neither current_owner nor is_capital is runtime state.
source_map_meta.rail_semantics: Land-border railway_connection describes printed rail. Legacy coast railway_connection artwork is retained pending AM-229 and grants no rail movement into a sea. printed_rail_coverage is true when a land-border railroad establishes coverage, otherwise unknown. Gauge changes require verified gauges on both sides, never ownership.

feature_uncertainties.rail_region_membership: The rulebook capacity table names seven regions but audited territory memberships are not complete. Do not infer from current control.
feature_uncertainties.narrow_crossing_naval_paths: Blocking seas are known where recorded; exact naval transit and facility access intersections are not yet fully traced.
feature_uncertainties.river_routes: Deferred with AP-086. A combat river crossing is not a navigable river network.

scenario_manifest.artifact_scope: Map projection and campaign specification only; playable setup and rules are not implemented by this manifest.

campaign.setup_basis: Official July 1936 starting pieces on included tiles only; off-map pieces omitted. M0 records 99 deployed units, 3 additional setup factories and 19 distinct static map facilities. The user retains the national Heavy Cruiser in queue #2 and Fleet Carrier in queue #3 without inventing a starting tile; their source-audited paid values are in the Japan setup specification.
campaign.mongolia_turn_policy: Separate Mongolia acts under direct Comintern control at the original USSR turn position, including movement and recruitment. No USSR participant account or territory incorporation is created.

m0_specification.treasury_authority: Theatre adjustment user-approved; use min(official starting IPP, retained directly possessed original land IPP) for Japan, KMT and CCP. Controlled and unaligned minors have no treasury. FEC, British Commonwealth and USSR participant accounts are excluded.

agent_control.minor_control: Mongolia is directly assigned to Comintern; other minors and Chinese warlords follow the retained control, alignment and influence rules.
agent_control.notes: Alliance agents preserve distinct national possessions and turns. Mongolia retains its minor identity and uses the USSR turn position; no USSR or FEC participant account exists. One alignment roll applies to the whole warlord.

wealth_objective.accounting: Count each physical facility once by ID and each undirected land-border railway connection once. Split rail value equally between endpoint possessors, then aggregate alliance shares. Value unfinished construction at cumulative payments already made; on completion replace that value with full catalog value less any remaining repair price. Never count both. Preserve national ledgers when aggregating a side.

known_limitations: Tannu Tuva is excluded by user choice; global source uncertainties are preserved and do not create scenario possessions.

The map itself does not contain starting units, setup factories, construction queues or mutable diplomacy. Frozen M0 files define a specification, not an implemented playable initial state or runtime rules.
Hong Kong/FEC and USSR are excluded. Mongolia retains its separate identity under direct Comintern control and is not Soviet-possessed.
Hokkaido's P7 port access is deliberately absent because P7 is outside this closed map.
Outside neighbors and any facilities carried solely on those edges are removed. Cut-edge provenance is not a movement, supply or reinforcement interface.
Convoy lines are disabled by the manifest even when a complete line is local. No convoy or interdiction mechanism operates in this profile; the world map keeps its source convoy data.
Rules whose prerequisites exist only outside this theatre are inactive in this profile; no external events or off-map income are supplied implicitly.

campaign_mechanics.scope: Retain other applicable rules; external prerequisites are inactive and no off-map nation, income or event is supplied implicitly.

notes: Static map projection only; not a playable scenario or initial unit setup.
Internal node/edge data is unchanged; all excluded neighbors are removed.
boundary_cuts is provenance only and must not create movement or supply routes.
Complete geographic routes are retained only when all endpoints, path nodes and controllers are included; facility sea accesses follow retained coasts.
Manifest-disabled feature layers remain empty even when their complete geography is retained.
